strings_by_text.libre_desc_dynamic_i18n: Replaces UI text from built-in or external JSON language files. Turn off to restore Chinese.
strings_by_text.libre_desc_custom_font: Applies .ttf or .otf fonts from HuashijiePro/fonts/ across the UI. Select System Default to restore.
strings_by_text.libre_desc_instant_launch: Skips the startup countdown and opens directly to the draft gallery. Turn off to restore the original startup screen.
strings_by_text.libre_desc_hide_community: Hides the Community and Discover tabs on the home screen, leaving local drafts only. Turn off and restart to restore.
strings_by_text.libre_desc_hide_topbar_cloud: Hides cloud sync icons on the gallery top bar and ignores taps so login prompts do not open. Turn off to restore.
strings_by_text.libre_desc_hide_draft_cloud_tick: Hides cloud sync icons and progress bars on draft thumbnails. Turn off to restore.
strings_by_text.libre_desc_optimize_create_canvas: Hides the online templates button and centers Custom Canvas, Pixel Art, and Open Image. Turn off to restore.
strings_by_text.libre_desc_touch_outside: Exits active Lasso selection with a tap outside the selection bounds without affecting Magic Wand, Polygonal Lasso, or active guides. Turn off for button exit only.
strings_by_text.libre_desc_free_ref_rotation: Enables two-finger rotation inside the floating reference window with an 8-degree anti-tilt deadzone. Turn off for pan and zoom only.
strings_by_text.libre_desc_floating_sliders: Adds a 2x2 drag handle between the brush size and opacity sliders to move them on screen. Turn off to dock them at the side.
strings_by_text.libre_desc_clean_speedpaint: Removes the corner brand watermark during timelapse playback and video export. Turn off to keep the original watermark.
strings_by_text.libre_desc_local_brush: Allows editing, renaming, and duplicating preset and imported brushes without account checks. Turn off to restore checks.
strings_by_text.libre_desc_system_share: Routes image, PSD, PDF, brush, and .hsj exports to the Android Share Sheet. Turn off for the built-in share menu.
strings_by_text.libre_desc_storage_transparency: Displays active local .hsj draft and export folder paths inside Draft Storage Settings. Turn off to hide this card.
strings_by_text.libre_desc_block_telemetry: Stops xCrash and MarsXlog logging libraries from initializing at startup. Turn off and restart to restore.
strings_by_text.libre_desc_offline_user: Supplies an in-memory local profile when signed out so login-gated local tools such as PDF export work offline without overwriting signed-in accounts. Turn off and restart to revert.
strings_by_text.libre_banner_restart_needed: Some changes take effect after restarting the app
